review.scope: Source-bound semantic review for feature 317: all seven new runtime UI messages for example settings packs, including actual form-applied versus accepted CSV-key counts, renames, unknown or retired keys, settings available elsewhere, unreadable rows, and loaded/missing-pack statuses.
review.limitations: AI-assisted semantic review against the current canonical English source; not human native-speaker review or approval. Exact source, context where applicable, hashes, placeholders, code literals, and protected UI names are preserved. Generated catalog publication is separate.
